WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
        a.acct_ref,
        -- PCI components
        COALESCE(rm.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'credibility_score', '0')::numeric as cred_score,
        COALESCE(rm.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'reputation_score', '0')::numeric as rep_score,
        COALESCE(p."usrn_Ent", 0) as profile_completeness,
        -- NGV components
        nm."FollGrow",
        nm."FingGrow",
        -- BBI components
        COALESCE(ba.behavioral_anomaly_scores->'automation_spam'->>'bot_likelihood', '0')::numeric as bot_ll,
        COALESCE(ba.behavioral_anomaly_scores->'automation_spam'->>'automated_behavior', '0')::numeric as auto_beh,
        COALESCE(im."ConvNat", 0) as conv_nat,
        -- CAS components
        COALESCE(rm.risk_profile->'risk_scores'->>'authenticity_score', '0')::numeric as auth_score,
        COALESCE(im."TxtUniq", 0) as txt_uniq,
        -- TEI
        COALESCE(ba.behavioral_anomaly_scores->'pattern_scores'->>'technical_pattern', '0')::numeric as tei,
        -- Cluster size (max)
        MAX(ca."ClusterQty")::numeric as cluster_size
    FROM accounts a
    JOIN risk_and_moderation rm ON a.acct_ref = rm.acct_risk
    JOIN behavioral_scores ba ON a.acct_ref = ba.acct_beh
    JOIN interaction_metrics im ON a.acct_ref = im.acct_dm
    JOIN network_metrics nm ON a.acct_ref = nm.acct_node
    JOIN profiles p ON a.acct_ref = p.acct_anchor
    LEFT JOIN account_clusters ac ON a.acct_ref = ac.acct_bridge
    LEFT JOIN cluster_analysis ca ON ac.clu_ref = ca.CLSTR_PIN
    GROUP BY a.acct_ref, rm.risk_profile, p."usrn_Ent", nm."FollGrow", nm."FingGrow", 
             ba.behavioral_anomaly_scores, im."ConvNat", im."TxtUniq"
),
scores AS (
    SELECT *,
        -- PCI = 0.3 * credibility + 0.3 * reputation + 0.4 * profile_completeness
        0.3 * cred_score + 0.3 * rep_score + 0.4 * profile_completeness as pci,
        -- NGV = sqrt(FollGrow^2 + FingGrow^2)
        SQRT("FollGrow"^2 + "FingGrow"^2) as ngv,
        -- BBI = 0.4 * bot_likelihood + 0.3 * automated_behavior + 0.3 * (1 - ConvNat)
        0.4 * bot_ll + 0.3 * auto_beh + 0.3 * (1 - conv_nat) as bbi,
        -- CAS = 0.3 * authenticity + 0.3 * content_uniqueness + 0.4 * conv_nat
        0.3 * auth_score + 0.3 * txt_uniq + 0.4 * conv_nat as cas
    FROM base
)
SELECT 
    AVG(pci * (1 - ngv) * (1 - bbi * cas * cluster_size)) as avg_nts
FROM scores;
